clause_text: 3.2 50/50 Musical Composition (Publishing) Split Sheet. Because the Artist wrote the lyrics and vocal melody and the Producer composed the original instrumental music, the copyright and publishing income in the underlying musical composition of "Jua Kali" shall be co-owned equally as a work of joint authorship under the Copyright Act (Cap. 130): fifty percent (50%) by the Artist and fifty percent (50%) by the Producer. Each Party may register its respective 50% share directly with KECOBO and MCSK, and neither Party shall grant a commercial brand synchronization license for the Track without the other Party's written consent (not to be unreasonably withheld).

clause_text: 4.2 No Uncleared Samples Warranty & Mutual Audit. The Producer warrants that the instrumental beat is one hundred percent (100%) original and contains no uncleared third-party audio samples or loops, and shall indemnify the Artist against any copyright takedown or third-party claim if an uncleared sample was used by the Producer. Each Party shall have the right once per year upon 30 days written notice to inspect the other Party's royalty statements relating to the Track, and either Party may terminate any breached license upon 30 days written notice if a material breach or non-payment is not cured. This Agreement is governed by the laws of Kenya.
